description: This PHP class 'Password' provides methods for handling password hashing, verification, and security checks within the Goteo project. It supports multiple encoding schemes including SHA-1 and bcrypt, and includes functionality for encoding passwords and assessing their security status.

classes.name: Password
classes.description: A class for managing password hashing, validation, and compatibility with multiple hashing algorithms including SHA-1 and bcrypt.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Password object, determining encoding type based on the provided hashed password.

methods.name: getContext
methods.description: Creates and returns a Context object configured with bcrypt rounds for password hashing.

methods.name: isPasswordValid
methods.description: Validates a given password against the stored hash, supporting SHA-1, bcrypt, and other password verification methods.

methods.name: isSecure
methods.description: Checks if the stored password hash is using a secure hashing method (not outdated like SHA-1).

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Hashes a raw password string, ensuring compatibility with previously encoded passwords.

methods.name: isBlowfish
methods.description: Checks if a string appears to be a Blowfish hash.

methods.name: isSHA1
methods.description: Checks if a string is a SHA-1 hash.

methods.name: isOldBcrypt
methods.description: Checks if a string appears to be an old bcrypt hash.
